chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: The private part of the believer is only that which is between the navel and the anus.

key_terms.بَيْنَ السُّرَّةِ وَالْكَرْبِزَةِ: Between the navel and the anus
key_terms.عَوْرَة: Private part; area of the body that must be covered

ai.seo_question: What is the definition of awrah for a believer according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) defining the 'awrah' for men during prayer as the area between the navel and the anus, a view that distinguishes the Ja'fari school from other Sunni madhhabs which often include the shoulders or knees. This narration underscores the jurisprudential principle that the minimum 'awrah' is sufficient for the validity of prayer, provided the area is covered, reflecting the Shia emphasis on textual evidence from the Ahl al-Bayt in deriving fiqh rulings.
